app_users_username_check.name: app_users_username_check
app_users_username_check.value: username = lower(btrim(username)) AND char_length(username) BETWEEN 1 AND 50

chunks_source_check.name: chunks_source_check
chunks_source_check.value: (document_id IS NOT NULL AND brief_id IS NULL) OR (document_id IS NULL AND brief_id IS NOT NULL)

documents_department_check.name: documents_department_check
documents_department_check.value: department IS NULL OR department IN ('d1', 'd2', 'd3', 'd4', 'd5')

documents_direction_check.name: documents_direction_check
documents_direction_check.value: direction IS NULL OR direction IN ('HUMINT', 'OSINT', 'IMINT', 'SIGINT', 'CYBINT', 'GEOINT', 'MASINT', 'TECHINT', 'FININT', 'TACINT_CI')
